headline: Portugal's Profligacy Pardoned by Late Ruthlessness
story: Portugal dominated possession and pressing from the outset, but squandered the match's clearest opportunities in a chaotic opening quarter. Three big chances gone begging—blocked, saved, missed—in the first sixteen minutes left Gonçalo Ramos and his teammates frustrated. Croatia, camping deep with only 2.4 high-press phases, absorbed the pressure and struck first through a low-xG chance at 53'. The game tilted on a knife's edge: Portugal were outplaying them, yet losing.

The numbers exposed Croatia's fatal weakness. Slow ball recovery—21.2 seconds versus Portugal's 13.1—meant they could never build momentum from transitions. Ramos (7.7) led the press that wore them down; Mateo Kovacic (7.4) fought valiantly in midfield but couldn't stop the tide. Portugal equalized at 68' with a genuine chance (0.79 xG), then punished late-game fatigue with a 90+4' goal from barely-expected territory (0.07 xG). Croatia's 6 shots on-target masked a deeper truth: they were never going to win this match.

keyMoment.text: Portugal's low-probability late goal—the only finish that mattered when the pressure finally broke through.

home.verdict: Controlled and won, but one moment of poor finishing in the opening quarter threatened to undo it all.
points: Missed three big chances worth 0.86 xG in first 16 minutes—conversion rate, not creation, was the issue.
High pressing (9.8 phases) exhausted Croatia's recovery time; pressing worked when discipline held.
Late goal at 0.07 xG shows ruthlessness; could have cost them dearly if Croatia's save at 77' had fallen differently.

away.verdict: Defended deep but lacked the recovery pace and clinical edge to punish Portugal's early misses.
points: Ball recovery time (21.2s) too slow; Portugal's 13.1s dominance in transition broke defensive shape repeatedly.
Saved six shots but scored only once—clinical defending without attacking reward compounds low 1.17 xG.
Missed big chance at 77' (0.23 xG) in a match where one more goal changes the story entirely.

statLine: Portugal's 1.91 xG created genuine control; Croatia's 6 shots on-target created an illusion of resilience that their 21.2-second ball recovery time demolished.
